headerDisplay:
## SleepMe Dock Pro for Homebridge

Control your SleepMe Dock Pro devices through Apple HomeKit.

### Getting Started

1. **Create API Token**: Visit [SleepMe Developer Portal](https://docs.developer.sleep.me/docs/) to create your API token
2. **Add Token Below**: Paste your API token in the API Keys field
3. **Save & Restart**: Save configuration and restart Homebridge

### Features

- Control temperature and power state from Apple Home
- Receive low water level alerts
- Create HomeKit automations
- Support for multiple devices

---
footerDisplay:
### Need Help?

- **Documentation**: [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/DaveLinger/homebridge-sleepme-dockpro)
- **Issues**: [Report a Bug](https://github.com/DaveLinger/homebridge-sleepme-dockpro/issues)
- **API Token**: [Create Token](https://docs.developer.sleep.me/docs/)

### Tips

- Use **battery** water level type for most users (shows water % in Home app)
- Use **leak sensor** type if you want automations triggered by "leak detected"
- Lower polling intervals = more responsive but higher API usage
- Recommended: Keep default polling intervals unless experiencing rate limiting

api_keys.title: API Keys
api_keys.description: SleepMe API tokens for authentication. Get your token at https://docs.developer.sleep.me/docs/

device_ids.title: Device ID Allowlist
device_ids.description: Optional. Leave empty to add every Dock Pro on your account. If you list any device IDs here, ONLY those devices are added. Device IDs appear in the Homebridge log as 'Adding new accessory' entries.

supported_models.title: Supported Models
supported_models.description: Optional escape hatch. Defaults to DP999NA (Dock Pro). Devices reporting any other model are skipped, so newer SleepMe products (such as the ST501NA Sleep Tracker) are not added as thermostats that never update. If SleepMe ships a new Dock Pro with a different model code, add it here.

water_level_type.title: Water Level Alert Type

oneOf.title: Battery (Recommended)
oneOf.description: Shows water level as battery percentage in Home app

oneOf.title: Leak Sensor
oneOf.description: Shows as leak sensor - triggers 'leak detected' when water is low

oneOf.title: Motion Sensor
oneOf.description: Shows as motion sensor - triggers 'motion detected' when water is low

water_level_type.description: Choose how low water level alerts appear in HomeKit. Battery shows water %, leak/motion sensors are useful for automations.

active_polling_interval_seconds.title: Active Polling Interval (Seconds)
active_polling_interval_seconds.description: How often to check device status when active/on. Lower = more responsive but higher API usage. Recommended: 45 seconds.

standby_polling_interval_minutes.title: Standby Polling Interval (Minutes)
standby_polling_interval_minutes.description: How often to check device status when in standby/off. Recommended: 15 minutes to reduce API calls.

layout.title: API Tokens
layout.description: Add one or more SleepMe API tokens. Multiple tokens allow you to control devices from different SleepMe accounts.

items.helpvalue:
Device Filtering

By default every device on your account that reports the Dock Pro model (DP999NA) is added. Other SleepMe products do not report water level or water temperature, so they are skipped rather than added as thermostats that never update.

items.title: Device ID Allowlist
items.description: 🎯 Leave empty for all Dock Pros. Add IDs to restrict the plugin to specific devices.

items.title: Supported Models
items.description: 🏷️ Leave empty to use the default (DP999NA). Only change this if SleepMe ships a Dock Pro with a new model code.

items.title: Water Level Alert Type
items.description: 💡 Tip: Use 'Battery' for most users. Use 'Leak Sensor' if you want HomeKit automations triggered by low water.

items.helpvalue:
Polling Intervals

The plugin checks your device status at different rates depending on whether it's active or in standby. Adjust these if you experience rate limiting or want more responsive controls.

Warning: Setting intervals too low may result in API rate limiting (429 errors).

items.title: Active Mode Polling
items.description: ⚡ Check every X seconds when device is ON. Default: 45 seconds.

items.title: Standby Mode Polling
items.description: 😴 Check every X minutes when device is OFF. Default: 15 minutes.
